forum_announcement.html:
November 13 update: the short report and dashboard have been refreshed.

The original questions now average 59 forecasting accounts each; the September additions average 31. These are accounts per question, including some bots. There is still only one officially resolved outcome; the Mexico resolution request remains pending and unverified. The main forecast picture is steady.

Which forecast, at what threshold, would change a grant, campaign, or policy decision? We’d particularly like funders, advocates, and policymakers to name one. Add a response here or annotate the report with Hypothes.is.

AI prepared this preliminary report and update at David Reinstein’s direction. The forecasts are from the Metaculus community.
